title: E5 Task 4: DM system prompt + Hybrid rules contract + tool-call protocol
description: Encode the DM persona and the refined-Hybrid rules contract as the system prompt: narrate freely; all math/dice/state changes via tools; lookup_srd before running any creature. Define a text-channel tool-call protocol (the ModelClient contract is text-in/text-out, no native tool-use) so the orchestrator can parse tool requests and feed results back deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: system prompt states the Hybrid contract; tool-call protocol is documented and parseable; protocol round-trips in a unit test; build + test pass.
close_reason: DM system prompt + Hybrid contract + tool-call protocol implemented and verified
